**Sprint 3 Plan \- ArrowBerry rev. 1**

5/6/2026 \- 5/18/2026

 **Goal: Start implementing quality of life features that would make the app more desirable for a user, as the MVP has been completed.**

**\[user story 1\]** As an active user, I want to be able to rate each recipe so that the algorithm can be more catered towards what I like 

	**\[task 1\]** Create rating/review system to store how gauge how much a user liked each dish

	**\[task 2\]** Optimize algorithm with user feedback (display recipes a person is more likely to enjoy based on their feedback)

	**\[task 3\]** Add review text section to recipes

**\[task 4\]** Add ‘my reviews’ section to profile page

Total Time: 6 Story Points

**\[user story 2\]** As a forgetful person, I want a shopping list feature so that I can remember what I need to buy at the store

	**\[task 1\]** Create shopping list popup on pantry page

	**\[task 2\]** Implement list features  add, remove, edit, clear,  and a strikethrough option

**\[Task 3\]** Add ‘add missing ingredients to shopping list’ button on recipes

Total Time: 5 Story Points

**\[user story 3\]** As an environmentalist, I want the app to prioritize recommendations with food that may expire soon, so that I can reduce my waste

	**\[task 1\]** Reconfigure scraper to gather information about food expiratory periods

	**\[task 2\]** Populate that data into the food info database

	**\[task 3\]** Create a function to estimate how long the user has till food spoils.

	**\[task 4\]** Reconfigure recommendation algorithm to have a priority system

Story Points: 5 Story Points

**~~\[user story 4\]~~** ~~As a health cognizant person, I want to see the nutritional summary for each recipe~~

	**~~\[task 1\]~~** ~~Redefine scraper to grab nutritional info from recipes (if there is any)~~

	**~~\[task 2\]~~** ~~Create a function to gather basic nutritional information for a list of ingredients, apply that on the most used ingredients.~~

	~~**\[task 3\]** Create function to roughly estimate nutritional info about recipes with missing data~~

	~~**\[task 4\]** Populate missing data rows with best estimates~~

~~Story Points: 8 Story Points~~

\[user story 5\] As an active user, I want the camera page to be prettier and easier to use so that I can more easily take pictures of my receipts and have the text extracted. 

	\[Task 1\] Refactor how the camera looks to make it take entire page as opposed to small section of the page

	\[Task 2\] Remove unnecessary buttons such that the only buttons are take photo, upload photo, and retake photo

	\[Task 3\] Adjust the reasoning model such that it will also estimate the expiry date on each receipt item 

	\[Task 4\] Give user option to remove or edit specific items that are extracted from the receipt before items are actually added. 

Story Points: 5 points

\[User story 6\] As a user with allergies, I want to have the option/filter to avoid recipes that might be allergic to me.

	\[Task 1\] Create section in profile to allergy/dietary preferences

	\[Task 2\] Edit algorithm such that with a filter selected, you will not see recipes that fall under the selected category

Story Points: 4 Points
